SECTION C: (3 Marks Each)

Q28(A). The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 9. Also, nine times this number is twice the number obtained by reversing the order of the digits. Find the number.
OR
Q28(B). 2 women and 5 men can together finish an embroidery work in 4 days, while 3 women and 6 men can finish it in 3 days. Find the time taken by 1 woman alone and 1 man alone.

Answer / Solution (A):
Let tens digit = x and units digit = y.
Number = 10x + y
x + y = 9 ...(i)
9(10x + y) = 2(10y + x)
90x + 9y = 20y + 2x
88x = 11y => y = 8x ...(ii)
From (i): x + 8x = 9 => x = 1 => y = 8
Number = 18
Answer: 18

Answer / Solution (B):
Let woman rate = 1/x, man rate = 1/y
2/x + 5/y = 1/4
3/x + 6/y = 1/3
Let u = 1/x, v = 1/y
2u + 5v = 1/4 => 8u + 20v = 1 ...(1)
3u + 6v = 1/3 => 9u + 18v = 1 ...(2)
Solving gives: u = 1/18 and v = 1/36
So woman time x = 18 days, man time y = 36 days
Answer: Woman = 18 days, Man = 36 days
